facts.anchor: Alliera and Dallin stood silently on the threshold of her and Elora’s home.
The house was dark, shadows dancing across the painted flowers in the full moon’s glow.
She guessed that was what happened when your gardener up and died.
The one she and Elora bought for when they finally got to go to Tannenfell. Together.
She had no more tears to cry, but that didn’t stop her chest from physically aching
She closed the door to her old life, walking toward the docks that would carry her away from the past and into the future.
